exposure: Autologous platelet-rich plasma (PRP) application after cesarean section
cohort: 140 high-risk women undergoing elective cesarean sections at Arash women's hospital in Tehran, Iran.
finding: Applying autologous platelet-rich plasma (PRP) after cesarean section significantly improved wound healing (REEDA score), reduced scar formation (VSS), and decreased pain/discomfort (VAS) compared to usual care.
